$comment: Definition of done for the ChemLab gauntlet. Flip passes only with evidence (command output or inspected screenshot). Verify commands / acceptance are not edited to pass.

features.title: Offline-first: zero runtime network fetches
features.acceptance: No gstatic/CDN font or Environment preset fetches; scenes render with network access blocked in the probe.
features.verify: grep -rn 'gstatic\|preset=' src/ returns nothing network-bound; probe run with route-abort on external hosts still renders apparatus
features.evidence: iter-1/2: probe aborts all non-127.0.0.1 requests; every scene renders (shots iter6d-*, mob4-*). No gstatic/preset refs in src (grep clean).

features.title: Titration scene renders and completes
features.acceptance: Probe screenshot shows bench, stand, burette with graduations, flask, tile; scripted titration reaches endpoint with pink flask and correct titre.
features.evidence: probe/titrate.py exit 0: 20.00 after 4x5cm3, 23.85 endpoint, UI 'Endpoint reached', pink flask (f2-endpoint.png).

features.title: Clock reaction correct + visual
features.acceptance: Turbidity obscures cross over time; time scales inversely with [S2O3]; rate table fills; probe asserts endpoint times for two concentrations.
features.evidence: probe/clock.py exit 0: 40.0s @0.100M, 100.0s @0.040M, ratio 2.5, rate=1000/t rows exact (f3-results.png).

features.title: Enthalpy experiment correct + visual
features.acceptance: Adding Na2CO3 animates, temperature curve behaves physically, ΔH sign and magnitude match 9701/31/M/J/20 expectations.
features.evidence: probe/enthalpy.py exit 0: dT 10.1, q 1060.5, dH -21.2 kJ/mol, T2 32.1 (f4-done.png).

features.title: AAA scene look
features.acceptance: Lighting graded (no blown-out bench), real lathe-profile glassware, readable labels, composed camera per experiment. Blind side-by-side vs PhET/Labster shots does not embarrass.
features.verify: probe shots inspected each iteration; verdict logged in notes/progress.md

features.title: No dev artifacts in prod
features.acceptance: No Stats widget, no console errors in probe, lint clean.
features.verify: npm run lint && probe error log empty
features.evidence: npm run lint = 0 problems; probe console errors only the intentional blocked-request ERR_FAILED.

features.title: Mobile usable
features.acceptance: 390x844 probe shots show non-overlapping UI, tappable controls, legible text for all three experiments.
features.evidence: mob4-*.png: readings strip + bottom sheets, scene visible, controls tappable at 390x844.

features.title: Build + lint green, bundle sane
features.acceptance: npx vite build succeeds; main chunk code-split so first paint isn't blocked by three.js.
features.evidence: build: index 8.6kB gz + react 56kB gz first paint; three chunk 302.8kB gz lazy-loaded (LabViewport).

features.title: Installable PWA, full offline reload
features.acceptance: Service worker precaches entire app shell (js/css/fonts/icons); after first load the app reloads and every experiment renders with the network completely dead; valid manifest + icons.
features.verify: probe/offline.py exits 0 (server killed after first load; content-frac AND std-dev checked on 3D render)
features.evidence: iter-9: offline.py exit 0 — precache 17/17, menu + titration render after server shutdown (frac 0.998 std 61.5 @10s, offline-titration.png inspected). gstatic <link> removed; Inter+JBMono self-hosted woff2.

features.name: Meniscus-reading practice (burette to 0.05 cm3)
features.criteria: Practice panel in titration shows zoomed burette scale with meniscus at a random 0.05-grid value; checker grades exact/close/too-high-low; New reading re-randomises; live titration state untouched. Mobile (390x844) has its own toggle opening the same single instance.
features.evidence: probe/meniscus.py exit 0 (9 PASS incl. grading of +0.30/-0.05/exact, score 1/3, input reset); shots/iter11-meniscus.png inspected; titrate/clock/enthalpy/offline gates all exit 0 post-change. probe/meniscus_mobile.py exit 0; iter12-meniscus-mobile.png inspected.

features.name: Drag-to-pour interaction (clock)
features.criteria: Na2S2O3 beaker is grabbable in setup phase; dragging shows a drop-zone ring on the reaction beaker; dropping within range plays a tilt+stream pour that starts the reaction (same semantics as Mix & start); dropping elsewhere springs back; OrbitControls disabled during drag; button path still works after reset.
features.evidence: probe/pour.py exit 0 (real pointer drag 110,440 -> 615,415: reaction started, timer advancing, reset returns to setup); shots/pour-drag.png (ring affordance) + pour-stream.png (lip-aligned stream, timer 2.5s) inspected; all other gates titrate/clock/enthalpy/offline/meniscus/meniscus_mobile exit 0.

features.name: Drag-to-tip weighing boat (enthalpy)
features.criteria: Weighing boat with Na2CO3 sits on the balance pan in setup phase and is grabbable; balance reads 0.00 g while the boat is lifted; dragging shows a drop-zone ring on the calorimeter cup mouth; dropping within range tips the boat with a powder stream and starts the run (same semantics as Add Na2CO3 button); calorimeter lid appears only after setup; dropping elsewhere springs back; drop test is parallax-correct (pointer-ray at target height, not object position); button path still works after reset.
features.evidence: probe/tip.py exit 0 (real pointer drag 790,360 -> 420,335: run started, T2 animates 22.0 -> 32.1, reset restores setup); shots/tip-drag.png (ring over cup, balance 0.00) + tip-stream.png (tipped boat, powder stream, T2 rising) inspected; full regression titrate/clock/enthalpy/offline/meniscus/meniscus_mobile/pour/tip all exit 0; lint 0; build green (precache 20 entries). DragTipper.jsx extracted as shared component, ClockScene refactored onto it with pour.py still 0.

features.name: Interactive burette stopcock (press-and-hold to dispense)
features.criteria: PTFE stopcock key on the burette is grabbable; press-and-hold opens the tap (key rotates ~90deg, handle highlights, continuous stream from jet tip to flask surface) and dispenses continuously at ~1.4 cm3/s committed to the store in 0.05 cm3 quanta; releasing the pointer closes the tap immediately and flow stops; dispensing halts at endpoint or 50.00 cm3; buttons remain functional for dropwise addition; Reset burette returns reading to 0.00; camera controls disabled during hold.
features.evidence: probe/tap.py exit 0 (pointer-down at 572,380 held: reading advanced past 1.0 in <=12 s in 0.05 quanta; two equal reads after release prove flow stops; Reset burette -> 0.00); shots/tap-stream.png inspected (stream tip->flask, key rotated, live reading 0.40); full 9-gate regression titrate/clock/enthalpy/offline/meniscus/meniscus_mobile/pour/tip/tap all exit 0 + shot.py iter15 exit 0 (/tmp/reg15-summary.log); iter15-titration.png/iter15-clock.png inspected; lint 0; build green. Shared setControls helper moved to src/lib/controls.js (react-refresh/only-export-components).

features.name: Exam-style rate graph in clock calculations sheet
features.criteria: Show Calculations for the iodine clock renders an exam-style rate vs concentration graph (pure SVG, offline-first): axes with gridlines and labels, x point marks for each recorded (conc, rate=1000/t) result, dashed best-fit line constrained through the origin (m = sum(xy)/sum(x^2)), and a gradient readout ~250 s^-1 mol^-1 dm^3; with fewer than 2 recorded results a hint prompts the student to record more runs; graph updates as results are recorded/replaced.
features.evidence: probe/graph.py exit 0 (ran two real experiments 0.100 M -> 40.0 s and 0.080 M -> 50.0 s via Mix & start + Record; CalcSheet shows 2 rate-point marks, rate-fit line present and passing through SVG origin (44.0,200.0), rate-gradient 250.0 within 240-260); shots/graph-calc.png inspected (exam-authentic axes, points, dashed fit, gradient label); full 10-gate regression titrate/clock/enthalpy/offline/meniscus/meniscus_mobile/pour/tip/tap/graph all exit 0 + shot.py iter16 exit 0 (/tmp/reg16-summary.log); iter16 shots inspected; lint 0; build green.

features.name: Enthalpy cooling curve with heat-loss extrapolation
features.criteria: After an enthalpy run completes, the worked-calculations sheet shows exam-authentic thermometer readings every 30 s (solid added at t=150 s marked x, no reading), a pure-SVG temperature/time cooling curve (14 plotted points, solid least-squares cooling line over the measured region, dashed extrapolation segment back to the mixing time, vertical dashed line at t=150 s), the extrapolated temperature labelled on the graph, and a corrected-DH block: DT_corr from the extrapolated T, q_corr, DH_corr closer to the data-book -23.0 kJ/mol than the uncorrected value; section absent before a run or after Reset.
features.evidence: probe/cooling.py exit 0 (13 checks: readings table with x at t=150, 5 pre-mix readings at 22.0, t=180 reads 32.1, 14 plotted points, fit + extrapolation segments present, extrapolated T=32.7, DT_corr=10.7, DH_corr=-22.5 within 0.15 of expected, data-book value mentioned, cooling section gone after Reset); shots/cooling-calc.png inspected (readable readings table, exam-style graph with dashed extrapolation to open-circle marker at T=32.7); model: Tmix=targetT2+0.02*30, linear cooling 0.02 C/s, existing enthalpy gate untouched and still green in reg17; lint 0; build green.

features.name: Read-the-burette endpoint check
features.criteria: At titration endpoint the numeric reading is masked; student reads a zoomed scale (shared BuretteScale SVG, no data leak) and must type the exact 0.05-quantum reading to record the titre; wrong/non-quantum entries rejected with feedback; reveal helper after 3 misses; works at 390x844. Gate probe/read.py (19 checks incl. mobile) exit 0.
features.evidence: probe/read.py exit 0 (2026-08-11); strengthened probe/titrate.py exit 0; shots/read-endpoint.png, read-mobile.png

features.name: Guided mode: per-experiment step coach (learn-by-doing)
features.evidence: probe/guided.py exit 0 (17 checks: step ticking through full titration incl. read-check, toggle/pill 5/6, clock+enthalpy panels, mobile fit 390x844); shots guided-titration.png, guided-mobile.png inspected

features.name: Mock paper Q1 (S22) with real ECF marking scheme
features.evidence: probe/mock.py exit 0 (13 checks: all-correct 6/6; ECF chain 5/6 with checkmark-ecf; sloppy mean rejected); shot mock-paper.png inspected

features.name: Qualitative analysis experiment (9701 P3 Q3 ion ID, 5 unknowns)
features.evidence: probe/qual.py exit 0 (20 checks: CuSO4/ZnCl2/(NH4)2CO3 chemistry vs official QA notes, dropwise-before-excess enforcement, 2-mark ID with evidence requirement, no-evidence 0/2, guide 6 steps ticking, mobile fit); shots qual-scene/marked/mobile inspected

features.name: Clock (S23) + enthalpy (S20) mock papers — all 4 experiments now have exam practice
features.evidence: probe/mock2.py exit 0 (13 checks: unlock gating both papers, clock 6/6 correct + 5/6 ECF chain from wrong rate, enthalpy 5/5 with cooling-corrected Textrap + 4/5 ECF + sign rejection); shots mock-clock.png, mock-enthalpy.png inspected

features.name: Learner's guide course — menu-level learn-by-doing path with persistent progress
features.criteria: Menu shows a Learner's Guide entry with progress badge; panel lists 9 ordered milestones across all 4 experiments (technique -> analysis -> mock paper); milestones tick automatically from live lab state (CourseTracker) incl. mock-paper scores recorded to the store; Start jumps into the right experiment with the step coach open; progress persists in localStorage across reload; usable at 390x844.
features.evidence: probe/course.py exit 0 (19 checks: menu badge 0/9, 9 units listed, Start drops into titration with guide open, S22 endpoint + read-check auto-tick 2 units, badge 2/9, done unit loses Start btn, reload persists via localStorage chemlab-course-v1, mobile 390x844 panel fits); shots course-panel/progress/mobile.png inspected. Full 16-gate regression on same bundle: /tmp/reg23-summary.log all =0.

features.name: GitHub Actions CI — build + all 17 probe gates + auto-deploy on green
features.criteria: Push to main triggers workflow: npm build, Playwright chromium (swiftshader) runs tests/run_gates.py (all 17 vendored gates, env-overridable DIST/SHOTS), shots uploaded as artifacts; deploy job runs tools/deploy.py from repo secrets only after gates pass and verifies live bundle hash matches dist. Local sandbox gates keep working unchanged (defaults preserved).

features.name: Gravimetric analysis experiment — water of crystallisation to constant mass
features.criteria: 5th experiment: weigh crucible/sample, Bunsen heat-cool-weigh cycles with real constant-mass loop (>=3 heats, last two within 0.01 g), weighing locked while hot, one reading per cycle, x marked against the learner's OWN readings, guide steps, mobile 390x844; plus burette closed-tap drip bug fixed and gated both ways.
features.evidence: probe/grav.py exit 0 (28 checks; masses 23.45/25.91/24.83/24.66/24.65, x=7 accepted, x=3 rejected); shots grav-heating/marked/mobile.png inspected. probe/tap.py exit 0 incl. new 'tip drains briefly after release'=1 and 'no drip when closed'=0/0 checks.

features.name: Ultra graphics mode, zoom controls, landscape mobile, extra animations
features.criteria: Opt-in ULTRA quality tier (soft shadows, 2.5x DPR, 4096 shadow maps, contact shadows, richer env) persisted in localStorage and visibly different from HIGH; on-screen zoom +/- buttons plus working wheel/pinch dolly (two-finger DOLLY_PAN mapping); landscape phone 844x390 usable in titration and grav with guide auto-collapsed on short screens; new animations: drop splash ripple, flame point-light flicker.
features.evidence: probe/gfx.py exit 0 (15 checks: ultra vs high mean pixel diff 2.07, zoom-in diff 16.29 with zoom-out returning to 0.00, wheel diff 4.88, persistence 'ultra' after reload, landscape dispense buttons elementFromPoint==BUTTON, guide collapsed); shots gfx-ultra/gfx-landscape-titration/gfx-landscape-grav.png inspected.

features.name: Molar gas volume experiment (gas collection)
features.description: Impure CaCO3 + excess HCl; CO2 collected in 100 cm3 gas syringe; record until constant volume; % purity marked against learner's own final volume (±2%). Guide steps, course unit, mobile guide-collapse fix.
features.evidence: probe/gas.py 25/25 PASS + guided/course gates green (/tmp/g26.log, /tmp/g26b.log 2026-08-12); shots gas-running.png gas-marked.png

features.name: Organic functional-group analysis
features.description: 9701 P3 Q4-style deduction: 5 unknown organic liquids, 7 tests (2,4-DNPH, Tollens', Fehling's, acidified dichromate, bromine water, Na2CO3, iodoform). Marks class + evidence (deciding tests must be performed). Silver-mirror/ppt/decolourise visuals, water bath with steam, guide steps, 12th course unit.
features.evidence: probe/organic.py 21/21 GATE PASS + course gate 12-unit green (/tmp/g27b.log, /tmp/g27.log 2026-08-12); shots organic-mirror.png organic-marked.png organic-mobile.png

features.name: Electrochemical cells experiment
features.description: 9701 P3 Q3-style: identify unknown metal electrode (fb15-fb19: Mg/Fe/Ni/Pb/Ag) by measuring E cell vs Cu2+/Cu and Zn2+/Zn references. |dE| + polarity, Data Booklet E table, digital voltmeter, salt bridge, drooping wires. markElectro needs both references for evidence mark. Guide steps + 13th course unit.
features.evidence: probe/electro.py GATE PASS (/tmp/g29b.log 2026-08-12) after voltmeter recentred; spot regression course/organic/gas/electro all 0 (/tmp/g28b.log); shots electro-marked.png multi-angle reviewed

features.name: Paper chromatography experiment
features.description: 9701 AS technique: identify a two-dye food colouring (fb20-fb24) by developing a chromatogram, measuring spot distances vs 8.0 cm solvent front, entering Rf values (±0.05) and matching to a 5-dye reference table. Animated solvent front + migrating spots, ruler scaled to front travel, markChroma needs developed run + correct Rf for evidence mark. Guide steps + 14th course unit. Gate probe/chroma.py (17 checks incl. mobile).
features.evidence: gate run 2026-08-12: 17/17 PASS (/tmp/chroma2.out); course gate PASS with 14 units; multi-angle grid shots/chroma-angles-grid.png coherent

features.name: Flame-test identification practical
features.description: Qualitative-observation enrichment: identify Li+/Na+/K+/Ca2+/Cu2+ from flame colours using a reusable nichrome loop. Procedure requires dilute-HCl cleaning plus a confirmed colourless blank before evidence credit; dirty-loop sodium masking and cobalt-blue-glass diagnosis are modelled. Animated non-luminous Bunsen flame, five unknowns, evidence-based 2-mark conclusion, guide, 15th course unit and mobile controls.
features.evidence: tests/run_gates.py course flame exits 0: course 19 checks at 15 units; flame 18 checks covering dirty-loop mask, blank lock, lilac K, yellow Na, cobalt glass, 2/2 marking, guide 5/5 and 390x844 mobile (/tmp/chemlab-iter33-course-flame.log, 2026-08-12). Chemistry invariants node check green; flame-lilac/sodium/mobile and four-angle grid inspected.

features.name: Simple-distillation practical
features.description: Separation-technique enrichment: distil water from blue CuSO4(aq) using a supported round-bottom flask, correctly sloped Liebig condenser and open receiver. Learner chooses cooling direction, adds anti-bumping granules, heats electrically, tracks vapour temperature and distillate volume, records colourless water, and receives 3-mark evidence-based technique feedback. Reversed cooling, missing cooling and violent bumping are modelled; guide plus 16th course unit.
features.evidence: tests/run_gates.py course distill exits 0: course 19 checks at 16 units; distill 18 checks covering initial state, 0/3 preflight, reversed-flow warning, granule interlock, 100.0 C plateau, >=5 cm3 colourless distillate, 3/3 marking, guide 5/5, bumping safety and 390x844 mobile (/tmp/chemlab-iter34-course-distill.log, 2026-08-12). Pure model invariant checks and lint/build green; correct/bumping/mobile and revised four-angle grid inspected.
